informatique.name: La salle des ordinateurs · The Computer Room
informatique.alt: The ground-floor computer room on coding-club afternoon, painted in ink and gouache. On the left a closed wooden door; a tutor raises one finger as she teaches a girl and a boy on laptops at a round table; a boy in a yellow sweater opens his palms, sorry, as the grey computer mouse dangles by its cord over the table edge; a girl in purple goes back to the bookshelf. In the middle the glass front doors stand open onto stone steps and green trees. On the right a boy unrolls a printout so long it spills to the floor; a researcher in a white coat holds out his open notebook to a colleague beside an old beige computer; a tall black cabinet of blinking lights stands under the wood-and-steel staircase; a woman taps a code on the wall keypad; a screen shows a glowing globe wrapped in a net of lines; and a technician kneels to sew a torn net of blue cables with a big needle.

doors.label: le coin pause
doors.hint: Go through the wooden door to the break corner

doors.label: l'étage
doors.hint: Go up the stairs to the upstairs lab

etage.name: L'étage · The Upstairs Lab
etage.alt: The upstairs computer lab on test day, painted in ink and gouache, with a flat white ceiling and a skylight. On the left the staircase comes up beside a tall window with a big white satellite dish on the roof outside, and a girl points at it; a boy steers a flight simulator in front of a screen of clouds; a girl lets a crumpled ball of paper drop into a wicker bin; two girls kneel on the floor pushing two cable plugs together; a small boy named Donny in a lab coat presses one red dot onto a big empty graph on the wall. On the right a man in a grey suit ticks a checklist on his clipboard; a very large monitor glows on the desk; a little brass wind-up robot walks along the desk; a man plays the keyboard with both hands like a piano; and in a leather armchair a man presses the telephone receiver to his ear beside a rotary telephone.

doors.label: la salle des ordinateurs
doors.hint: Go back down the stairs to the computer room

pause.name: Le coin pause · The Break Corner
pause.alt: A cosy break corner with a tall window onto green trees and a potted plant. On the left a wooden door; a girl points inside an open computer case to show her friend the circuit board; a young woman on a bench raises her palm for a break beside her sandwich; on a green sofa a girl comforts her sad friend holding a games controller. On the right a man at his laptop tosses a paper airplane, a man breaks the red wax seal on a boxed software package, and a cheerful IT specialist in a magician's top hat waves a wand at an open computer, his toolbag at his feet.

doors.label: la salle des ordinateurs
doors.hint: Go back through the wooden door to the computer room
